articles.summary: I know why you’re looking into Page Object Model: you’re tired of fixing the same CSS selectors across five different tests every time someone changes a form. You copied the login steps a few times, the test suite grew, and now a small UI change means an afternoon of maintenance. POM gives those repeated interactions a home.
